children: Reckitt has become much more attractive after disposing of its essential home business, analysts at Bernstein say. The disposal has left a more focused health and hygiene portfolio with brands that lead the category, they add. However, the company still remains one of the more polarizing names in European staples, as it has lost sight of sustainable organic growth, the analysts say. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
